    Has Robert Downey Jr. ever received an Oscar?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Robert Downey Jr. won his first Oscar at the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024 for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Lewis Strauss in Oppenheimer. This marked his first win following previous nominations for Chaplin (1993) and Tropic Thunder (2009). 
    • Award: Best Supporting Actor (2024) - Oppenheimer
    • Previous Nominations: Best Actor (Chaplin), Best Supporting Actor (Tropic Thunder).
    • Speech Highlights: He thanked his "terrible childhood and the Academy, in that order," along with his wife Susan and the Oppenheimer cast and crew. 
    He also won a BAFTA and a Golden Globe for the same performance.
